title: The boy at the front desk

cues.text: Inside, a lobby with sofas and a front desk. You walk up to the desk.
A boy in striped pyjamas peers over the top of the front desk. He snaps his fingers and is gone, and you turn around.
The boy stands in the hall in front of you. He breaks apart into specks and appears again at the end of the front desk, by the sofas. A closed book lies on the desk.
The boy has opened the book on the desk; beside it lie a quill pen and a bell. You step up to the desk and pick up the pen.
